items.title: help backlog missing --failed filter documentation
items.intent: aishore help backlog must list the --failed flag. FEAT-109 added --failed to backlog list but cmd-help.sh was not updated — users reading help to discover filters will not find it.
steps: In .aishore/lib/cmd-help.sh, in _help_backlog(), add --failed flag under the list subcommand options, aligned with the other filter flags (--ready, --no-ready)
items.groomingNotes: Doc regression from FEAT-109: one-line fix in cmd-help.sh _help_backlog(). Small scope, clean verify.

items.title: Regression suite pre-flight fails due to stale FEAT-105 references
items.intent: Every sprint pre-flight must pass when all shipped features still work. The regression.jsonl must not contain verify commands that reference archived items by ID — those commands fail the moment the item is cleaned from the active backlog.
items.description: regression.jsonl has 3 entries (from FEAT-107 and FEAT-109 sprints) that reference FEAT-105 directly: two run 'backlog show FEAT-105' expecting failCount output, and one runs 'backlog list --failed | grep FEAT-105'. FEAT-105 is archived — not in backlog.json — so all three fail on pre-flight before every future sprint. This blocks all sprint execution.
steps: Identify the 3 stale lines in backlog/archive/regression.jsonl: two with itemId FEAT-107 that use backlog show FEAT-105, and one with itemId FEAT-109 that greps for FEAT-105 in backlog list --failed output
Remove those 3 lines from regression.jsonl using a targeted delete (jq filter, not sed) so the file remains valid JSONL
Verify the remaining regression entries parse correctly with jq

acceptanceCriteria.text: regression.jsonl has no entries containing FEAT-105
regression.jsonl remains valid JSONL after the fix

items.lastFailReason: Baseline validation failed before developer ran
items.groomingNotes: Confirmed: 3 stale entries in regression.jsonl reference FEAT-105 (archived). Blocks all sprint pre-flights. Must priority correct. Fix: remove those 3 JSONL lines.
